en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural bathing pond or small lake with people swimming and standing along a wooden enclosure at the shoreline. Two people are in a flat-bottomed boat on the water, while others stand or sit along the fenced edge under trees. The setting appears pastoral, with open fields and tree lines in the background. At the top in red print is German text indicating the location as Mahlitzsch near Dommitzsch and referring to the Mühlteich bathing area.
